package.description: Do you want to run apps? The runtime includes everything you need to run existing apps/programs built with .NET Framework. Not necessarily to be confused with «Microsoft .NET Runtime».

en-US.description: Do you want to run apps? The runtime includes everything you need to run existing apps/programs built with .NET Framework. Not necessarily to be confused with «Microsoft .NET Runtime».
en-US.longDescription:
Do you want to run apps? The runtime includes everything you need to run existing apps/programs built with .NET Framework. Not necessarily to be confused with «Microsoft .NET Runtime».

Normally the runtime is installed by default with all x64 versions of Windows 11, and with x64 and x86 versions of Windows 10 22H2, which as of January 14, 2026 causes complications with the Winget verification process. Due to that, this package can by default only be installed on ARM64 devices, and users of x64/x86 versions of Windows 10 ≤21H2 cannot use this package even if they are still on Framework 4.8.0.
en-US.name: Microsoft .NET Framework Runtime 4.8.1

es-ES.description: ¿Quiere ejecutar aplicaciones? El entorno de ejecución incluye todo lo que necesita para ejecutar aplicaciones o programas existentes compilados con .NET Framework. No debe confundirse necesariamente con «Entorno de ejecución de .NET».
es-ES.name: Microsoft .NET entorno de ejecución (ARM64)
